tool.name: GeneFior
tool.description: Multi-tool gene detection with user-provided databases
tool.command:
mkdir -p output_dir &&
#if $sequence_type == 'Paired-FASTQ': #set $input_str = $input + ',' + $input_r2 #else: #set $input_str = $input #end if
GeneFior -i '$input_str' -st '$sequence_type' --db-path '$db_path' -o output_dir -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4}
#if $tools: --tools #echo ' '.join($tools)# #end if
#if str($sec_thresholds.report_fasta): --report-fasta '$sec_thresholds.report_fasta' #end if
#if $sequence_type == 'Genes-FASTA': --genes-type '$genes_type' #end if
--q-min-cov $sec_thresholds.q_min_cov --q-min-id $sec_thresholds.q_min_id --d-min-cov $sec_thresholds.d_min_cov --d-min-id $sec_thresholds.d_min_id --d-min-depth $sec_thresholds.d_min_depth --d-min-reads $sec_thresholds.d_min_reads --detection-system '$sec_thresholds.detection_system'
#if $sec_advanced.mode == 'dna-only': --dna-only #elif $sec_advanced.mode == 'protein-only': --protein-only #end if
#if str($sec_advanced.sensitivity) != 'default': --sensitivity '$sec_advanced.sensitivity' #end if
--minimap2-preset '$sec_advanced.minimap2_preset' --blastx-task '$sec_advanced.blastx_task'
#if str($sec_advanced.evalue): -e $sec_advanced.evalue #end if
#if $sec_advanced.fastp_trim and $sequence_type == 'Paired-FASTQ': --fastp-trim #end if
#for $tp in $sec_advanced.tool_param: --tool-param '$tp.tool_name=$tp.params' #end for
$sec_advanced.verbose
&& cd output_dir && det=\$(find . -name '*_detection_matrix.tsv' | head -1) && mv "\$det" '$detection_matrix' && evi=\$(find . -name '*_evidence_matrix.tsv' | head -1) && mv "\$evi" '$evidence_matrix' && evs=\$(find . -name '*_evidence_summary.tsv' | head -1) && mv "\$evs" '$evidence_summary' && all=\$(find . -name '*_allele_resolution.tsv' | head -1) && mv "\$all" '$allele_resolution' #if str($sec_thresholds.report_fasta): && rep=\$(find . -name '*_report.fasta' | head -1) && mv "\$rep" '$report_fasta' #end if && cd .. && zip -r '$results_archive' output_dir

param.name: input
param.label: Input sequences
param.help: FASTA or FASTQ file (.gz accepted). For Paired-FASTQ, provide R1 here

param.name: input_r2
param.label: R2 mate (Paired-FASTQ only)
param.help: Second read file for paired-end FASTQ input

param.name: sequence_type
param.label: Sequence type
param.help: Specify the input type: Single-FASTA, Paired-FASTQ, or Genes-FASTA

param.name: genes_type
param.label: Genes type (Genes-FASTA only)
param.help: Required when sequence type is Genes-FASTA: DNA or amino-acid sequences

param.name: db_path
param.label: Database path
param.help: Comma-separated paths to user-provided database directories (built with build_database.sh)

tool.help:
@GENEFIOR_HELP@
**GeneFior** — General-purpose gene detection with user-provided databases
This tool runs the GeneFíor pipeline with user-provided reference databases. The database directory must be set up using the `build_database.sh` script shipped with GeneFíor, which creates the expected subdirectory structure (`blast_dna/`, `blast_aa/`, `diamond/`, `bowtie2/`, `bwa/`, `minimap2/`).
**Outputs:**
- **Detection matrix** — Binary presence/absence per gene and tool - **Evidence matrix** — Qualified per-tool evidence statuses - **Evidence summary** — Evidence, candidate-allele, and exact-allele counts - **Allele resolution** — Family-level top candidate and competing alleles - **Report FASTA** *(optional)* — Sequences passing detection thresholds - **Results archive** — Full output directory (zip), usable as input to Recompute, Gene-Stats, or Combine
